name: Apocalypse 2059
source:
In 2030, an event known as "The Cataclysm" forever changed the face of Earth. Nuclear weapons claimed lives in an instant, plunging the world into a devastating nuclear winter that lasted over a decade. Civilization, law, and morality crumbled into dust. The surface became an inferno, forcing what little plant life remained to retreat underground. For the few who survived, existence became a constant battle against extinction.

Twenty years have passed. The pre-war generation grows old, while a new generation rises, knowing nothing of the world that came before.

The story takes place in the year 2059. You, the protagonist, have been living in solitude in a shelter since your birth. These peaceful days are changed by the appearance of a mysterious woman. At her urgent request, you'll embark on a perilous journey across the savage lands of what was once civilization.
